sentences.quote:
Russ Miller, Senior Executive Vice President, COO U.S. and Mexico Operations, will retire.
His retirement is effective February 2026.
sentences.text: Caton Frates became Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer for Warehouse Operations in the U.S. and Mexico in February 2026, succeeding Russ Miller, whose retirement as COO for U.S. and Mexico operations was announced in an 8-K in August 2025.
The fiscal 2026 annual report states that Executive Vice President Jim C. Klauer, COO of the Northern Division until August 2026, will retire effective October 30, 2026.

On the September 2026 earnings call, Vachris said tariff refunds were predominantly used to lower prices on produce, meat, beverages and some home and hardware items, and he highlighted delivery of furnishings and appliances falling from four to five weeks to three or four days.

sentences.quote: "We've not displaced people because the business is growing at a faster rate," Vachris said at The Economic Club of Chicago earlier this month.
sentences.text: In May 2026 he said growth meant technology had not displaced staff.

sentences.text: Ron M. Vachris became chief executive in January 2024, elected by the board after serving as president and chief operating officer since February 2022, in what the company described as the culmination of a long-standing succession plan, making him only the third CEO of a company he joined over forty years earlier as a forklift driver, having since held every major operating and merchandising role.

sentences.quote: Costco ended fiscal 2025 with 914 stores, finished fiscal 2026 with 939, and plans to bring that total to 967 stores in fiscal 2027.
sentences.text: Execution remains expansion-led: Costco ended fiscal 2025 with 914 warehouses, fiscal 2026 with 939, and plans 967 in fiscal 2027.

Capital allocation is conservative, with a $1.30 quarterly dividend rate, $903 million of fiscal 2025 buybacks under a $4 billion authorization, plus a $15 per share special dividend, roughly $6.7 billion, in fiscal 2024.
